orgBranding.heading: Branding
orgBranding.help: What people see on the sign-in page at your organization's address, and in the invitations you send. Leave a field empty to use Provisa's own presentation.
orgBranding.displayNameDesc: Shown above the sign-in form and used in invitation subject lines.
orgBranding.primaryColorDesc: Buttons and active states. Also the invitation button.
orgBranding.accentColorDesc: The rule beside your name on the sign-in page.
orgBranding.welcomeDesc: One line shown under your name on the sign-in page.
orgBranding.inviteDesc: Your own sentence, placed above Provisa's copy in every invitation you send.
orgBranding.logoDesc: PNG, JPEG, SVG or WebP, up to 256 KB.
